text:
Leah: OrbitalSI just asked if Redwood can accept offline device backfills up to 96h with automatic credits. They propose a `claim_id` + `proof_manifest` for each batch. Need quick alignment: policy, dedupe, and telemetry.

Billing Bot: partner spec uploaded: /partners/orbitalsi/usage_v2.json. sample payload includes claim_id and a signed manifest.

Marco: 96h auto-credit is large. Finance prefers 24-48h. We can accept ingest longer, but auto-credit window should be conservative unless they provide strong proofs.

Tasha: Support impact: customers will ask for retro invoices. Console should surface `claim_id`, `manifest_hash`, and `signed_at` and mark auto-credited rows.

Vik: eng notes: require HMAC or JWT on every batch, persist unique key on (partner_id, claim_id). Also store manifest_hash to verify proofs on replays or voids.

Leah: partner says many devices buffer 3-4 days in remote networks; 96h is their hard requirement for go-live. They will provide manifest proofs but not guaranteed monotonic seq on device level.

Marco: possible compromise: default policy = 48h auto-credit. Offer enterprise contract option: extended 96h auto-credit if OrbitalSI (a) provides signed manifest per claim, (b) agrees to replay-rate SLA, and (c) accepts a monthly liability cap.

Vik: implementable flow: 
- verify signature and manifest hash before enqueue 
- if unique(claim_id) -> ingest 
- if signed_at >= now-48h -> apply auto-credit 
- if now-96h <= signed_at < now-48h and partner=enterprise_pilot -> apply auto-credit if manifest proof passes verification; else ledger_state=review_required 
- signed_at < now-96h -> reject

Tasha: KB blurb draft: "We accept backfilled usage up to 96 hours. Automatic credits apply for reports within 48 hours by default. Partners on an extended agreement who provide signed manifests may be eligible for a 96-hour automatic credit window. Older reports are reviewed manually."

Ops Bot: added telemetry metric marketplace.partner.claims.orbitalsi.replays.count and a dashboard draft: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/orbitalsi-backfills

Leah: owners: Vik (eng) to prototype claim_id dedupe + manifest verification, Marco (finance) to draft enterprise clause & cap, Tasha (support) to draft KB & console columns, Leah (partnerships) to communicate the compromise. I'll tell OrbitalSI we can pilot 96h for enterprise customers pending tests and a liability cap.

Billing Bot: partner uploaded test bundle: s3://orbitalsi-tests/backfill-samples-20260320.tar.gz

Marco: finance tentatively ok for pilot 96h if eng proves dedupe / manifest verification and we limit exposure.

Vik: I'll run a replay-sim and add unit tests. queueing job now.

Leah: thanks team. I'll update the partner and track follow-ups in #PRT-7788.
